title: H&E-predicted expression yields a 32-gene prognostic signature in head and neck cancer
summary: A transformer framework (CTransPath) predicted gene expression from H&E slides, and a 32-gene signature (MGP_HNSC32) built with random survival forest stratified TCGA-HNSC patients (progression-free interval HR 4.13, overall survival HR 2.42, disease-specific survival HR 4.88). In the independent HANCOCK cohort (n = 701) the prespecified score was associated with progression-free survival (HR 1.40, 95% CI 1.03-1.90), but the continuous score was not. The authors call the expression-prediction step proof of concept.
ai_technology: CTransPath transformer predicting gene expression from H&E images, with random survival forest signature
organization: Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University

evidence.tested: Independent HANCOCK cohort using prespecified coefficients and cutoff.
evidence.unknown: Weak external association; continuous score not significant; no prospective validation; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Transformer predicts expression from slides to build the signature.
